blocks.content: Quiz: Why do we pass key={entry.id} instead of key={index} when rendering the list?
Tap an option below to answer:
Using index would make the list render in reverse order
Index does not reverse the order.
Index does not reverse the order.
React requires keys to be numbers
Keys can be strings or numbers; the important thing is uniqueness and stability.
Keys can be strings or numbers; the important thing is uniqueness and stability.
A unique id stays the same for that entry even if the list is reordered or items are removed
Index changes when the list changes, but a unique id is stable per entry.
Index changes when the list changes, but a unique id is stable per entry.
The array key is used internally by React; it's not for the component's props.
